position: 493 binary mutation-position indicators, irrespective of amino acid identity
selection: A: mean inner Spearman; ties by historical proportional top mean S; then negative per-target MSE
inner_top_fraction: 15/66, historical training rule unchanged; reporting cutoff 30
training: 81 observed C labels, masked per target, never zero-imputed
metrics: Spearman, Kendall, Top30 overlap / mean S / random expectation; subgroup Top30 NA if n<30
zero_shot: unchanged additive reference masked log odds; higher score ranked higher; no assay fitting or sign tuning
ties: descending score then construct_id, fixed for every method
scope: development-stage retrospective ablation; not independent validation
resources: CPU2; no GPU; no dependencies installed
